sys_script.description:
STRY0019513 04/02/26 - Enforce State Transitions Complete/Reopened
Server-side validation to enforce state transition restrictions as a safety net for the client script. - From Complete (400): Can only transition to Reopened (8) - From Reopened (8): Can only transition to Complete (400)
Prevents invalid state changes via list edits, APIs, or browser developer tools. Aborts the transaction and displays an error message if an invalid transition is attempted.
sys_script.name: Enforce State Transition Restrictions
